about: Controlled terms for the knowledge-base keys (docs/proposals/0003-knowledge-base.md). scripts/kb.py refuses any term not listed here. Adding a term is a deliberate edit: check that no listed term already means the same thing, and say why in the commit. Never rename or delete a term that rows use.

row_kinds.case-decision: What a Lab case tried for a register problem, with its evidence or runs
row_kinds.design-rule: A general rule or worked example from a book or review on choosing operations; keyed by behaviours, operation and conditions, a register problem only when it is about one
row_kinds.simulation-rule: How to make a unit or plant converge or meet a target, from a book or review; keyed by operation and symptom, never by a register problem

outcome_statuses.worked: A paper, a measurement or a CHEPTA run shows the operation giving the decision's expected change under the row's conditions
outcome_statuses.failed: A paper, a measurement or a CHEPTA run shows the operation not giving it, or the calculation not converging, under the row's conditions
outcome_statuses.untested: Proposed for this problem; nothing has tested it yet
outcome_statuses.lead: Named only by an AI or by a paper's literature review, without results of its own

outcome_bases.measured: Plant or laboratory measurement reported by a source
outcome_bases.paper_simulation: A simulation reported by a paper (its simulator named in the evidence)
outcome_bases.chepta_run: An executed CHEPTA run; names its engine version
outcome_bases.lab_inference: Reasoning by a Lab session; can only be untested or a lead
outcome_bases.textbook: A book's or review's rule or worked example, with a chapter, section, page, table or example locator. A rule without results of its own is a lead; a worked example with numbers can be worked or failed

symptoms.about: Simulation symptoms. The first four are the rows of the troubleshooting table in docs/SIMULATION_PRACTICES.md; the others name CHEPTA outcomes seen in the cases (NO_CONVERGENCE, a phase refusal, long run times).

terms.feed-refused: The first unit refuses the given feed
terms.section-fails: Units run separately but a section fails
terms.recycle-drift: The loop closes but purity drifts when the tolerance is tightened
terms.purity-short: A column converges but misses a target
terms.no-convergence: A unit or loop does not converge
terms.wrong-phase: The phases found or allowed are not the ones expected (for example a refused two-liquid calculation)
terms.slow: A run converges but takes too long to use in scans

components.about: CHEPTA component names exactly as CHEPTA's requests and results spell them. Seeded from the case results in this repository; add a name only after checking it with CHEPTA's info capability.

statement_limits.about: A rule row's statement is Lab's own paraphrase, never copied text (docs/LICENSING.md).
